nodes.description: Conditional endothelial Dgke deletion reproduces thrombotic microangiopathy and proteinuria via impaired VEGFR2/Akt signalling and loss of COX-2/PGE2; a stable PGE2 analog reverses both.

Global Dgke-null mice show subclinical glomerular endothelial and basement-membrane anomalies that worsen with age and develop capillary occlusion under nephrotoxic stress, with impaired glomerular COX-2/PGE2.

Endothelial injury and platelet-fibrin microthrombi occlude glomerular capillaries, with a chronic thrombotic microangiopathy on biopsy and a membranoproliferative-like glomerular pattern in some patients.

nodes.description: DGKE phosphorylates arachidonoyl-diacylglycerol back toward phosphatidic acid, feeding the phosphatidylinositol (PI) cycle that regenerates PIP2. Its loss depletes PIP2, disrupting PIP2-dependent signalling in both the glomerular endothelium and the podocyte.
